changeSet.author: agimate
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE connectors ADD CONSTRAINT chk_connectors_disclosure CHECK (disclosure IN ('EAGER', 'LAZY'));

changeSet.author: agimate
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE skills ADD CONSTRAINT chk_skills_disclosure CHECK (disclosure IN ('EAGER', 'LAZY'));

changeSet.author: agimate
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE agent_skills ADD CONSTRAINT chk_agent_skills_disclosure CHECK (disclosure IS NULL OR disclosure IN ('EAGER', 'LAZY'));

changeSet.author: agimate
changeSet.sql: UPDATE skills SET disclosure = 'LAZY', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AND deleted_at IS NULL AND name IN ('acp', 'astro', 'board', 'divination', 'platform', 'sheets') AND disclosure != 'LAZY';

changeSet.author: agimate
changeSet.sql:
UPDATE agent_presets SET skill_names = skill_names || ARRAY['skill-loader'], updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE name IN ('health-diary', 'platform-admin') AND NOT (skill_names @> ARRAY['skill-loader']);
UPDATE agent_presets SET skill_names = skill_names || ARRAY['tool-loader'], updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE name IN ('health-diary', 'platform-admin') AND NOT (skill_names @> ARRAY['tool-loader']);

changeSet.author: agimate
changeSet.sql:
UPDATE skills SET md_content = replace(md_content, ' Инструменты `platform.*` (их схемы у тебя уже есть).', ' Инструменты — `platform.*`.'), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AND name = 'platform' AND md_content LIKE '%их схемы у тебя уже есть%';
UPDATE skills SET md_content = replace(md_content, ' The tools are `platform.*` (you already have their schemas).', ' The tools are `platform.*`.'), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AND name = 'platform' AND md_content LIKE '%you already have their schemas%';
